# Product Form Audit Report

Audit date: 4 October 2026. Mode: **READ_ONLY_AUDIT**. NubiBill ERP / Flutter / SQLite runtime / Firestore REST synchronization.

## 1. Executive Summary

**The Product Master cannot be certified as complete or consistently metadata-driven.** Every active category/subcategory record in the available account database was inspected; active templates were resolved and the current Add/Edit renderer was traced. This report is the sole authorized file output. No fixes were applied.


| Measure | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Active Category → Subcategory record combinations checked | 149 (148 SYSTEM + 1 legacy BUSINESS) |
| Distinct combinations currently offered after name deduplication | 139 |
| Fully clean combinations | 0 |
| Highest combination severity: CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW | 138 / 4 / 7 / 0 |
| Visible choices: CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM | 128 / 4 / 7 |
| Entirely absent ACTIVE field template | 1; no SYSTEM combination has zero active rows |
| Profiles with declared fields missing from active rows | 37 |
| Profiles with PRODUCT/VARIANT placement disagreements | 69 |
| Profiles with default disagreements | 74 |
| Profiles with option disagreements | 128 |

Severity totals are mutually exclusive: each record is counted once at its highest **combination-specific** finding, including explicitly identified domain recommendations. Shared repository/API risks are reported separately in section 3 and do not automatically label all forms CRITICAL. Every nonempty form has at least the conversion-preview issue; the remaining choice lacks a template, so none is fully clean.

The most widespread critical failure is converted-sale activation retaining a selling container as Base Unit outside template choices on 137 forms, with both UI and write validation accepting it. Other local failures are nine forms whose PRODUCT Fixed Colour condition cannot be resolved across variants, nine putty/filler/cement-paint records that offer ready-colour/tintable modes without shade/base identity fields, and Hand Sanitizers exposed despite an explicit Paints exclusion. Some important defaults are currently correct: Ceiling Paints (Interior / Ceiling / Litre), Metal Primers (Metal / Fixed Colour / Red Oxide / Litre), Wall Putty (Interior / Wall / White / Kilogram / Bag), and Basement Waterproofing (Interior & Exterior / Concrete, Wall, Floor). Other findings still affect those forms.

### Evidence and limits

Catalogue evidence: `/Users/sksuman/Documents/nubibill-test1-bcebe-C6btLkx5SyZvUQOzOeUUd7XxsFh2.db`; schema version 3; 9,728,000 bytes; initial SHA-256 `01ece1205198b3d978ca87e519d6bdd151b100a9d40a23bbebfa741fd7aee3b3`. SQLite was opened using Python `mode=ro&immutable=1`, without application initialization. No WAL or rollback journal was present. The available Hardware business has two Paints outlets; stored aliases BT-HARDWARE and BST-PAINTS map to HARDWARE/PAINTS. Other accounts, unsynchronized server data and future BUSINESS overrides are **UNKNOWN**.

ACTIVE means `isDeleted=0` and `status='ACTIVE'`, matching master queries. Raw active IDs and display-name deduplicated choices are distinguished. Shadowed records are audited because existing data may reference their IDs. Detailed forms use the available business context; it has no active BUSINESS template/definition overrides and one active BUSINESS attribute option.

Results are **static code/data traces**, supported by read-only SQL and an in-memory reconstruction of inspected Dart resolution rules. Flutter widgets, app startup, migrations, repair scripts, formatting, tests, analyzer and REST/Firestore operations were not executed. Fresh pixel-level results and network traces are UNKNOWN. Existing screenshots were inspected as historical evidence only. Domain advice is labeled **INFERRED_DOMAIN**; exact chemistry/packaging remains UNKNOWN without the actual product specifications.

### Integrity inventory

- Duplicate category: SYSTEM and BUSINESS **Interior Wall Coatings**. The BUSINESS record has zero active children; current selector prefers SYSTEM.
- Duplicate subcategories: 10 same-parent normalized-name groups / 20 records / 10 surplus records. IDs and winners appear below.
- Active orphan subcategories: **0**. All active parents exist and are active.
- Entirely missing ACTIVE field template: legacy **Paint → Interior Wall Paint**, `PM_SUBCATEGORY_ce0bf39843417fca`, parent `PM_CATEGORY_93d0611d84196d62`. Selector offers it; UI warns and blocks Save after selection.
- Embedded profile readiness: **146 ACTIVE profiles / READY**; **Miscellaneous** and **Hand Sanitizers** are UNAVAILABLE with no embedded profile; the legacy Interior Wall Paint has neither.
- templateSelectable: **true 25 / false 88 / absent 36**; current selector ignores it. Eighty-nine records contain templateIssues, often schema-vocabulary complaints about absent “allowedSellingUnits”/“allowedOptions” despite nonempty row templates. These are not 89 entirely missing templates.
- Active template rows: **2,290**, including **2,258** under current active decoded child IDs. **0** duplicate active `(subcategoryId, attributeId)` keys; **0** references to unavailable attribute definitions.
- Orphan active template groups: 18 rows under `SYS_SUBCATEGORY_SYS_CATEGORY_INTERIOR_WALL_COATINGS_CEILING_PAINTS`, 14 under `SYS_SUBCATEGORY_SYS_CATEGORY_WATERPROOFING_BASEMENT_WATERPROOFING`. Decoded subcategory IDs now use shorter IDs, which also have usable rows; current Ceiling/Basement templates are not absent.
- Zero effective SELECT/MULTI_SELECT fields have zero available options. The global `sellingUnit` SELECT definition alone has no global options, but both applicable templates supply their own.
- Invalid selectable defaults: **5 combinations**, section 11.
- Legacy active records: Paint/Interior Wall Paint, duplicate BUSINESS Interior Wall Coatings, legacy BUSINESS unit “L”, and 10 duplicate subcategory groups. Similar but differently named paint/wood families are review candidates, not proven duplicates.
- Saved references: **both ACTIVE nondeleted products** reference INACTIVE legacy category/subcategory IDs (Exterior Wall Paints and Accessories/Brush). One ACTIVE variant references a product ID absent from the products table. These confirmed reference problems are separate from the active combination matrix.

| Responsibility | Source | Behavior |

| Add/Edit/copy + dynamic renderer | [product_pages.dart](lib/presentation/products/product_pages.dart#L970) | One structured form state drives both modes, attributes, variants, conversion, tax and image. |
| Category/subcategory selection | [product_pages.dart](lib/presentation/products/product_pages.dart#L2246); [app_controller.dart](lib/presentation/app_controller.dart#L1341); [product_repository.dart](lib/data/repositories/product_repository.dart#L19) | Tenant/business + active SYSTEM values; child parent filtering; name deduplication. No subtype/exclusion/readiness filter. |
| Template, definitions and options | [product_repository.dart](lib/data/repositories/product_repository.dart#L114); [app_controller.dart](lib/presentation/app_controller.dart#L1326) | SYSTEM then BUSINESS merge; row options override global options; custom BUSINESS options may extend add-enabled fields. |
| PRODUCT vs VARIANT / defaults / conditions | [product_attribute.dart](lib/data/models/product_attribute.dart#L1); [product_pages.dart](lib/presentation/products/product_pages.dart#L1125) | Row attributeLevel and conditions drive most fields; condition.scope unsupported; widget also branches on literal business attribute IDs. |

Line anchors are navigation hints; inspect the named symbols if a viewer does not support them.


| ID / severity | Confirmed problem | Impact / expected behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A01 / CRITICAL | Create/edit repository do not reject empty loadTemplate=[]; UI does. | A direct caller with valid classification/global units can bypass completeness. Validate active parent, child and nonempty profile at the write boundary. |
| A02 / CRITICAL | commercial/base units need only exist globally; packUnitId and agreement with attribute units are unchecked. | A caller can submit incompatible units; normal UI also retains the selling container as Base Unit on conversion activation for 137 forms (U02). Enforce one contract and validate picker membership. |
| A03 / CRITICAL | ANY_VARIANT conditions ignored; PRODUCT visibility not recomputed from variant changes. | Nine forms can save Fixed Colour without colour identity. Share scoped condition evaluation between renderer and validator. |
| A04 / CRITICAL | Edit Category change clears variantId/barcode/_sku and rows; edit repository creates new rows without reconciling omitted old rows. | Old SKUs can remain active under the reclassified product. Define identity-preserving reclassification or explicit retirement. |
| A05 / HIGH | templateProfile, templateSelectable, exclusions and readiness are not resolved by repository. | 37 missing-field, 69 placement and 74 default disagreements are present. Establish one validated metadata authority. |
| A06 / HIGH, conditional | SQLite metadata revision 5 vs current compiler revision 1; fingerprint includes code revision; compiler rewrites profiles/defaults. | A later successful import can regress current corrected Ceiling/Basement forms. Static forecast only; no sync performed. |
| A07 / HIGH | Wood branch matches category containing 'wood' before Enamels. | All eight installed Metal & Wood Enamel forms show Wood/Clear/PU Thinner signature. |
| A08 / HIGH | Two saved active products have retired classification IDs; Edit loads active selectors only. | Existing forms may not resolve. Reconcile aliases while preserving SKU identity. |
| A09 / HIGH | Last SYSTEM duplicate wins without query ordering; some document/payload IDs diverge. | Choice may change across refresh; use stable IDs and deterministic canonicalization. |
| A10 / MEDIUM | No complete missing-template diagnostic or warning log with categoryId/subcategoryId found. | Future diagnostic should enumerate every active child and explain failures. |

No field-change Firestore REST query was found in production wiring. Field changes update memory; template reloads call SQLite-backed queries. Background sync, authentication/session refresh and image URL loading are separate paths. Actual network traces are UNKNOWN because the app was not run.

The sync forecast follows the [compiler loop](lib/data/catalogue/system_catalogue_metadata.dart#L930), which deactivates non-profile rows and replaces levels/defaults. The [waterproofing branch](lib/data/catalogue/system_catalogue_metadata.dart#L1443) treats Basement as Exterior/Wall; the [wood branch](lib/data/catalogue/system_catalogue_metadata.dart#L1493) precedes Enamels. Current SQLite results below are the baseline, not a post-sync simulation.

### Field-by-field appendix — all 149 combinations

Each block contains resolved PRODUCT and VARIANT rows, exact types/options/defaults/required rules and the resulting initial state of a fresh Add form with one variant. Technical rows are collapsed at first. Edit initializes saved values before reconciliation: the effective metadata is identical, but displayed values depend on the saved record; arbitrary saved values are UNKNOWN until that record is supplied.

A raw default is distinguished from its post-reconciliation value. Conditional defaults may be pruned when the field is hidden. Field eligibility means the condition is satisfied; paired units are rendered inside their numeric parent. Literal `unit` is hidden if Sold As exists without Pack Size, regardless of renderField. DefaultRules only run when defaultValue is null. A condition's `scope` is included verbatim even though the current model ignores it. Option values below are the effective merged row options, not the ignored embedded profile lists.

Every nonempty form shares these fixed controls: required Product Name (min 2 characters); required Brand/Company, Category and Subcategory; optional canonical HSN/SAC (4–8 digits when populated); Default GST (%) initialized 0 (0–28 range); Description; read-only generated SKU; optional Barcode; variant Status (ACTIVE/INACTIVE); optional variant GST override; Image URL preview. Edit additionally exposes saved Product Code and Product Status. No Selling Price, Purchase Rate, MRP or Opening Stock inputs occur. Technical Details starts collapsed. Image upload/search buttons are disabled; Paste URL is supported.

| Issue | Severity | Evidence class | Finding | Recommended action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| U01 | MEDIUM | CONFIRMED | Conversion preview appears with '?' before valid inputs; Contains changes do not trigger a rebuild. | Show preview only after valid quantity and base unit; refresh it on input. |
| T03 | MEDIUM | CONFIRMED | Active rows outside declared profile field lists: segment, warranty. | Choose one authoritative profile contract and remove drift. |

| S04 | MEDIUM | CONFIRMED | templateSelectable=false is ignored by normal selectors. | Separate real invalid profiles from schema-alias diagnostics; filter only validated choices. |
| U02 | CRITICAL | CONFIRMED | Enabling converted sale retains Base Unit=Can, outside template base choices (Litre, Millilitre). **Findings and recommended behavior**

| Issue | Severity | Evidence class | Finding | Recommended action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| U01 | MEDIUM | CONFIRMED | Conversion preview appears with '?' before valid inputs; Contains changes do not trigger a rebuild. | Show preview only after valid quantity and base unit; refresh it on input. |
| T03 | MEDIUM | CONFIRMED | Active rows outside declared profile field lists: mixingRatio. | Choose one authoritative profile contract and remove drift. |
| P01 | HIGH | CONFIRMED | Active row level contradicts profile: productColour. | Resolve placement contract; migrate values without changing SKU identity. |
| D01 | HIGH | CONFIRMED | Profile defaults differ from effective rows: surface, colourType. | Compile reviewed defaults consistently; retain valid user overrides. |
| O01 | MEDIUM | CONFIRMED | Profile option restrictions differ from effective rows: usage, surface, finish, soldAs. | Unify allowed option sources and validate aliases. |
| B01 | HIGH | INFERRED_DOMAIN | Wood-only Surface, Clear / Transparent Colour Type and PU Thinner defaults are inherited by Enamel Paint; they do not describe the enamel family reliably. | Use the exact enamel/resin profile; support metal and ready colours; confirm thinner with product data sheets. |
| U02 | CRITICAL | CONFIRMED | Enabling converted sale retains Base Unit=Can, outside template base choices (Litre, Millilitre). Picker falls back to the global selected unit and validates only nonnull; repository accepts its global ID, so a positive Contains can save a wrong container-based conversion. | Clear incompatible base selection when enabling conversion; validate membership and canonical/attribute agreement before saving. |

**Findings and recommended behavior**

| Issue | Severity | Evidence class | Finding | Recommended action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| U01 | MEDIUM | CONFIRMED | Conversion preview appears with '?' before valid inputs; Contains changes do not trigger a rebuild. | Show preview only after valid quantity and base unit; refresh it on input. |
| P01 | HIGH | CONFIRMED | Active row level contradicts profile: productColour. | Resolve placement contract; migrate values without changing SKU identity. |
| D01 | HIGH | CONFIRMED | Profile defaults differ from effective rows: usage, finish. | Compile reviewed defaults consistently; retain valid user overrides. |
| O01 | MEDIUM | CONFIRMED | Profile option restrictions differ from effective rows: usage, finish, soldAs. | Unify allowed option sources and validate aliases. |
| B18 | MEDIUM | INFERRED_DOMAIN | PU Thinner and Gloss are generic defaults shared across distinct wood resins/finishes; exact correctness is UNKNOWN without product specifications. | Choose subtype/resin defaults from reviewed product data sheets. |
| U02 | CRITICAL | CONFIRMED | Enabling converted sale retains Base Unit=Can, outside template base choices (Litre, Millilitre). Picker falls back to the global selected unit and validates only nonnull; repository accepts its global ID, so a positive Contains can save a wrong container-based conversion. | Clear incompatible base selection when enabling conversion; validate membership and canonical/attribute agreement before saving. |

## 7. Wrong Field Types

The four explicitly controlled attributes are correctly SELECT in current applicable rows:


| Field | Current type/options | Assessment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Recommended Coats | SELECT: 1 Coat; 2 Coats; 3 Coats; 4 Coats; As Required; Not Applicable | Controlled vocabulary is present where applicable. Applicability/defaults may still be wrong. |
| Dilution / Thinner Type | SELECT: Water; Mineral Turpentine / MTO; Paint Thinner; PU Thinner; Epoxy Thinner; Manufacturer Recommended Thinner; Ready to Use; Two Component; Not Applicable | Controlled vocabulary is present; generic options are broader than many product families. |
| Brush Type | SELECT: Flat; Angle; Round; Wall Brush; Varnish Brush; Utility Brush | Correct controlled type/options. |
| Bristle Material | SELECT: Synthetic; Nylon; Polyester; Natural Bristle; Mixed Bristle | Correct controlled type/options. |

Pack Size and dimension fields are NUMBER with positive-size constraints in applicable templates; Grit is SELECT. Current primer Product Colour rows are SELECT, including Metal (Red Oxide/Zinc Yellow/Grey/White) and Wood (White/Pink). No effective TEXT row with a nonempty controlled options list was found; this report does not invent such a defect.

Coverage, Dilution Ratio, Drying / Recoat Time, Warranty, Shelf Life, Mixing Ratio, VOC and Film Thickness are TEXT. These can legitimately contain ranges, conditions and compound measurements. **INFERRED_DOMAIN / MEDIUM:** add structured number/unit or separate components where searching/calculation requires them; do not indiscriminately replace every technical TEXT with NUMBER. Recommended Coats and Dilution Type currently sit in main specifications; other technical information is generally collapsed. The per-template appendix gives the actual section.

**Confirmed legacy-value type risk:** one saved ACTIVE product has numeric Recommended Coats=2 while current controlled values are strings such as “2 Coats”; three saved active Brush variants have brushSize values “2”/“4”/“5” stored as strings and size unit in legacy unit='inch'. Current NUMBER validation rejects a retained string if it reaches write validation. Reconciliation checks options for SELECT/MULTI_SELECT but does not coerce all NUMBER strings. These saved records also have inactive classification IDs, so current active form loading is already obstructed. Safe alias/type normalization must preserve real data; arbitrary replacements with defaults are not evidence of correctness.

Most disagreements place Fixed Product Colour in VARIANT while the embedded profile declares PRODUCT. For a product-wide fixed colour, PRODUCT placement is the intended contract; for separately stocked ready colours, Shade/Colour, Shade Code and Colour Family belong to each variant. These must not be mixed into one literal-name widget rule.

Nine other forms actually put Product Colour at PRODUCT but place Colour Type on VARIANT, with an ANY_VARIANT predicate. Current ProductAttribute evaluates only its local values and optional PRODUCT fallback; it never scans variants. Moving a field without changing condition evaluation therefore fails.

Pack Size/Pack Unit, finish/shade/base, brush/roller sizes, grit and tape dimensions are variant metadata. Brush Type/Bristle Material are currently PRODUCT; that is reasonable when one product is a single brush design with size variants. If one product represents several designs, a different profile would be needed; manufacturer/product grouping intent is UNKNOWN.

Canonical HSN and default GST are product fields. Optional variant GST is an explicit tax override and is not a duplicate same-purpose field. No dynamic hsnCode field occurs in the effective active templates; canonicalization still excludes that legacy attribute.

## 9. Colour / Tinting Problems

### Confirmed broken pathways


| Issue | Combinations | Current behavior | Expected behavior |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C01 / CRITICAL | [F017](#f017) Automotive Coatings → Automotive Coatings<br>[F020](#f020) DIY & Aerosols → Spray Paints<br>[F069](#f069) Pipe & GI Coatings → GI Coatings<br>[F070](#f070) Pipe & GI Coatings → Pipe Coatings<br>[F071](#f071) Powder Coatings → Powder Coatings<br>[F112](#f112) Textures & Special Effects → Designer & Decorative Finishes<br>[F113](#f113) Textures & Special Effects → Exterior Textures<br>[F115](#f115) Textures & Special Effects → Interior Designer Textures<br>[F116](#f116) Textures & Special Effects → Interior Textures | Choose variant Fixed Colour: PRODUCT Product Colour remains hidden/nonrequired, and write pruning omits it because ANY_VARIANT is unsupported. | Evaluate the cross-variant predicate, or move the controlling mode to PRODUCT with an explicit consistent contract. |
| C02 / CRITICAL | [F095](#f095) Putty & Surface Preparation → Acrylic Putty<br>[F096](#f096) Putty & Surface Preparation → Acrylic Putty<br>[F097](#f097) Putty & Surface Preparation → Cement Paint<br>[F098](#f098) Putty & Surface Preparation → Cement Putty<br>[F099](#f099) Putty & Surface Preparation → Crack Fillers & Repair Compounds<br>[F100](#f100) Putty & Surface Preparation → Surface Fillers<br>[F101](#f101) Putty & Surface Preparation → Wall Putty<br>[F102](#f102) Putty & Surface Preparation → Waterproof Wall Putty<br>[F103](#f103) Putty & Surface Preparation → Waterproof Wall Putty | Choose Multiple Ready Colours or Tintable Base: Fixed Product Colour hides; no Shade or Base Type exists; colour/base identity can be absent on save. | Restrict to supported modes (often Fixed Colour for white putty), or add complete mode-specific variant identity. |
| P01 / HIGH | 69 profile/row placement disagreements, listed in §8 | Fixed Product Colour frequently renders in VARIANT despite profile declaring PRODUCT. | Compile and validate the intended placement and migrate old values. |

Supported mode labels are **Fixed Colour, Multiple Ready Colours, Tintable Base, Clear / Transparent, Not Applicable**. Most coating templates correctly condition Shade/Shade Code/Colour Family on ready colours and Base Type/Base Code on tintable mode. Clear/Transparent and Not Applicable hide these colour/base fields; current metadata generally does not force unnecessary shades for these modes. Current active templates contain **no colourMode row**, so there is no confirmed present-day duplicate Colour Type/Colour Availability control. The widget nevertheless contains legacy colourMode/colourType hardcoding and a hardcoded White fallback in the legacy Fixed Colour branch.

ProductAttribute supports a narrow “Tintable”/“Tintable Base” alias and legacy Ready Colour mapping for a colourMode condition. It ignores declared valueAliases (present in 97 combinations). A legacy value “Ready Colour” is not one of the new colourType SELECT options; reconciliation can clear it and substitute the current default. The actual affected-record count is UNKNOWN; metadata alias presence is not proof of data loss. For 88 combinations defaultRules are present; a nonnull defaultValue wins before those rules. A saved Base Type with absent mode can therefore be reconciled to the generic ready-colour/clear default rather than inferred Tintable Base, and hidden-base pruning can remove it. This is a conditional migration/edit risk, not an executed mutation.

### Family assessment


| Family | Current behavior | Domain judgment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Interior/exterior wall coatings | Usually Multiple Ready Colours; Shade and Colour Family become required; base fields available only on tintable choice. | Colour pathway generally exists, but mandatory Colour Family may burden data entry; exact allowed paint modes should be template-specific. |
| Ceiling Paints | Correct Ceiling surface; Multiple Ready Colours; Fixed Colour appears at VARIANT; row Usage options broader than profile Interior restriction. | Surface correction is present. Fixed colour level and allowed option contract still disagree. |
| Metal / Wood / wall primers | PRODUCT Colour Type defaults Fixed; Product Colour SELECT shown; optional other colour modes have conditional variant fields. | Metal colour choices and Wood White/Pink are correct. Limit mode options to validated primer products rather than assuming all five modes. |
| Epoxy Primers | White default is invalid against Grey/Red Oxide; default Surface Wall and Water; Mixing Ratio missing. | Confirmed profile disagreement; restore reviewed epoxy profile and validate actual chemistry. |
| Enamels | All eight inherit Wood-only, Clear/Transparent, PU Thinner; Satin Enamels defaults Gloss. | HIGH domain mismatch; use enamel-specific coloured/metal-capable profiles and verified resin/thinner. |
| Wood finishes | Clear/Transparent default, PU Thinner and Gloss shared across different resin families. | Clear mode is appropriate for some finishes, not all stains/dyes/treatments; manufacturer specifics UNKNOWN. |
| Protective/industrial coatings | Most have ready colour/tint paths; generic liquid-paint base lists apply broadly. | Verify industrial factory colours and actual tintability; exact permitted bases cannot be inferred from category alone. |
| Powder coatings | Factory powder family still offers liquid-paint Tintable Base choices; ANY_VARIANT Fixed Colour broken. | Use powder colour/finish identity; tintability requires explicit process support. |
| Putty/fillers | White Fixed PRODUCT defaults work, but all five colour modes offered without shade/base fields. | Critical incomplete selectable modes; restrict or complete them. |
| Waterproofing | Most omit colour fields entirely. | Acceptable for non-colour-identifying compounds; coloured/white heat-reflective membranes need optional colour where performance/stock identity depends on it. |

Nerolac documents enamel use on metal/wood/masonry and satin/gloss families, supporting the conclusion that universal Wood/Clear defaults are unsafe. [Nerolac enamel range](https://www.nerolac.com/decorative-paint-products/metal-paints.html). Nerolac describes powder coatings as solvent-free particulate resin/pigment systems, supporting separate powder metadata rather than unverified liquid tint bases. [Nerolac powder coating process](https://www.nerolac.com/industrial-paints/powder-coatings/why-powder-coatings.html). Asian Paints documents a white heat-reflective membrane and shade-dependent reflectance, showing why colour can matter for some waterproofing products; applicability to every local subcategory is an inference. [SmartCare Damp Proof product sheet](https://www.asianpaints.com/content/dam/asian_paints/products/product-information-sheets/smartcare-damp-proof.pdf).

## 10. Unit / Pack / Conversion Problems

### Confirmed behavior

- Current nonempty templates generally restrict dropdown units rather than offering every global unit. No current semantic PACK_UNIT row contains Can/Bucket/Bag/Box/Piece/Roll container options. Category-based compiler source still contains such mixed allowedUnits lists; distinguish future compilation risk from current data.
- Measurement length fields use template unit options intersected with global LENGTH units. Brush/Roller offer inch/mm/cm; tape Width uses mm/cm/inch and Length uses Metre/cm/mm; wallpapers use Metre/cm/mm. DIY Stickers and Stencils & Wall Art also have actual Width/Length unit-pair metadata. Do not mistake their shared definition fields for absent pairing.
- **U02 / CRITICAL, 137 forms:** OFF initializes base=commercial (Can/Bag/Bucket, etc.). Switching ON only sets _packaging=true and never recalculates _baseUnit. unitPicker falls back to the globally known retained value even when outside options; its validator checks only selected != null. Thus a completed Putty form can enable conversion, enter Contains=20, leave Base Unit=Bag and pass save with packUnit=Kilogram / soldAs=Bag / baseUnit=Bag / factor=20. Expected: clear the incompatible base and require Kilogram (or another allowed measurement unit) before preview/save. This is a confirmed static path, not an executed transaction. It affects all 137 container-packed forms; the 10 sold-by-only forms and sanitizer do not have this particular default mismatch.
- **A02 / CRITICAL:** repository validates global unit existence, not allowed units or agreement with attribute/canonical units; packUnitId is unchecked. The renderer's narrower lists alone cannot guarantee inventory integrity.
- Base unit menu uses literal unit/PACK_UNIT options, not conversionUnitOptions. If its set is empty or yields no master match, it falls back to all global units. Only the entirely missing-template resolver has this global fallback in the evaluated catalogue; that form is blocked in the normal UI.
- Hidden selling unit `unit` and visible `soldAs` coexist on Brush, Roller, Tape, Sandpaper and Wallpapers. _applyUnitDefault takes the first selling-semantic field, often hidden unit. Changing visible Sold As may update displayed metadata while internal caches still derive from hidden unit; conversion preview and canonical save use different sources.
- Hand Sanitizers has generic Unit, no PACK_UNIT semantic role and no explicit selling attribute. It shows Pack Size + Unit and fabricates Sold As, while pack/selling caches lack a metadata default. Save prefers literal unit over that fabricated selling selection. Scope it out of Paints.
- Conversion defaults **OFF** on fresh Add and successful subtype changes. Edit derives ON from stored factor/unit difference; that is intentional preservation, not a default-on defect.
- ON validates finite Contains >0 and requires Base Unit. Preview appears unconditionally, including “?” before valid entry; typing Contains does not call setState, so preview is not live until another rebuild. Repeated same-unit conversions are possible. Templates do not control whether the checkbox is appropriate.
- Save writes factor=1 and base=commercial when OFF, or user factor/base when ON. Package measurement and sell-by container fields are separate in current packed templates. For products sold by count without pack size, save can still synthesize packUnitId from base/commercial fallback.

New subtype reconciliation replaces an old value when it matches the old default and resetDefaults is requested. It preserves a compatible non-default custom value. Therefore a value that differs from the new default is not necessarily stale: this is the explicit preservation rule. Lower-level profile defaults and active-row defaults must first be made consistent before transition behavior can be judged against one contract.

The following are **static traces**, not executed widget tests. **Confirmed successful clearing:** cross-category Putty→Primer removes Kilogram/Bag; Paint→Brush removes paint colour/coats/thinner state; Brush→Paint removes brush size and applies Exterior/Wall/Litre/Can plus ready-colour fields; Wallpaper→Putty removes roll/dimension units; Wood Finish→Waterproofing removes finish/colour/base fields. Conversion and caches reset on successful subcategory resolution. Same-category Primer→Metal removes/replaces old default Surface/Usage/colour/coats/thinner while preserving valid non-default Pack Size and row identity.

**Do not classify all preserved values as stale:** if an attribute remains at the same level, its value is allowed, and it differs from the old default, reconciliation deliberately preserves it. A customized Usage or Surface may survive same-category switching. Whether a more restrictive profile should disallow it depends on the target row options, which currently disagree with many embedded profiles.

Remaining problems:

**CRITICAL U02:** Conversion reset on subtype change is correct, but enabling conversion afterwards retains the OFF selling-container base on 137 target forms. For example Putty gets Kilogram/Bag correctly, then the conversion toggle can retain Base Unit Bag and save a factor against Bags. This is distinct from subtype stale-state clearing.


| Severity | Confirmed behavior / conditional risk | Expected behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CRITICAL | Cross-category Edit clears existing variant IDs and creates a fresh row. Repository update creates new variants and leaves omitted old variants intact. | Preserve existing SKU identity or explicitly retire/migrate old variants; never silently create mixed taxonomy under one product. |
| HIGH | Catalogue sync listener has a selected-ID check but no shared request/generation guard with direct subtype loading; its reconciliation does not reset conversion. | An interleaved same-ID refresh can replace newer template state/default assumptions. Use one atomic resolution generation; actual occurrence UNKNOWN. |
| HIGH | Sync listener catches template reload errors by setting _error; previous template/ready state can remain. Save repository re-resolves and may reject, but UI can display stale controls. | Invalidate readiness on a failed changed catalogue; display the reason and prevent stale form submission. |
| HIGH | Initialization has no subtype request-generation guard; form controls may become interactive before the final saved template load completes. | Prevent late initialization from applying a previous selection's template. This is a source-level race possibility, not a reproduced incident. |
| HIGH | Legacy valueAliases are ignored, and nonnull defaults outrank inference rules. Changing/migrating legacy ready-colour/base values can default then prune hidden shade/base. | Normalize known aliases before applying defaults; preserve compatible recorded identity. |
| MEDIUM | Add Variant initializes raw defaultValue only, without full reconciliation/defaultRules or immediate hidden pruning. Initial subtype load uses the richer reconciliation path. | Create each new row through the same fresh state engine. Repository pruning protects hidden attribute writes but initialization is inconsistent. |
| MEDIUM | Required measurement-unit save loop checks raw unit.required, not visibility/requiredWhen of its parent. | A future conditional dimension template could block Save on a hidden field. Current measured templates do not reproduce this condition; future risk only. |
| MEDIUM | Category handler preserves canonical Product Name, Brand, HSN, GST, description and image while clearing attributes. | Name/Brand/image preservation is useful; HSN/GST relevance after reclassification needs an explicit policy. No automatic tax-profile default is currently applied. |

Save serializes only currently visible template attributes and repository pruning repeats this check; ordinary hidden paint values are not automatically saved after a successful Brush transition. Internal keys survive reconciliation where needed but are not copied into attributeValues by the save loop. The broken ANY_VARIANT condition itself causes legitimate Product Colour to be treated as hidden, so generic pruning cannot compensate for incorrect condition semantics.

## 13. UI / UX Problems

### Shared source-level audit and visual evidence

[NubiForm layout](lib/presentation/widgets/nubi_form.dart#L69) wraps fields into two columns at width 620 and one below it; numeric/unit pairs use 420. Page actions move to a bottom Save button below 650. These are real responsive provisions. Exact pixel alignment, keyboard overlap, focus/accessibility and every device width remain **UNKNOWN** without a live run.

Historical [desktop screenshot](docs/product-form-desktop.png) and [mobile screenshot](docs/product-form-mobile.png) were visually inspected. They show readable grouped cards, aligned paired Brush size/unit on desktop, stacked mobile fields and a clear mobile Save action. They also show legacy “Accessories” and “How is this item sold?” controls differing from current source. They therefore cannot certify all current 149 forms. Desktop has an empty half-row beside Subcategory and generous card spacing; this is observed in the historical screenshot only.


| Check | Current evidence | Severity / recommendation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hints/examples | Every resolved attribute gets a metadata hint or generic renderer fallback; Product Name always uses paint example Rangoli Rich Matt. Technical Coverage hint uses sq.ft/L/coat even on mass-based adhesive/putty families. | MEDIUM: subtype-aware examples and units, particularly Coverage/Dosage/Mixing Ratio. |
| Labels / shop-user clarity | Sold As, Pack Unit and Base Unit coexist; semantic distinction is not fully explained. Generic Unit and VOC remain terse; some code IDs are kept internal rather than displayed. | MEDIUM: explain container vs measurement; expand specialist labels where useful. |
| Required markers | Dynamic labels use isRequired; Brand/Category/Subcategory are required by save but labels lack the same '*'. SKU appears required although generated/read-only. | MEDIUM: consistent markers and generated-field helper text. |
| Visible field load | Largest current fresh form has 13 initially rendered main metadata fields plus fixed identity, tax, SKU/status/image controls, per variant. Variant duplication repeats optional GST controls. | MEDIUM: review optional colour-family/grade fields and progressive disclosure; exact user task burden requires observation. |
| Technical grouping | Technical Details collapsed by default, maintains state; no current required technical rows. Coats/Thinner remain main fields. | Baseline grouping works; their applicability differs for additives/treatments. |
| Important fields hidden | PRODUCT Product Colour remains hidden in nine cross-variant cases; Tape product descriptors are absent. | CRITICAL/HIGH: correct metadata/condition behavior, not presentation-only changes. |
| Blank areas / spacing | Wrap grid can leave an unused half-row on odd field counts; cards add fixed spacing and optional empty sections may remain. | LOW/MEDIUM risk; current per-device severity UNKNOWN. |
| Misaligned controls | Measurement pairs are nested grids, MULTI_SELECT is full width; helper/action rows can produce different control heights. | Potential desktop alignment issue; no new screenshot evidence to assert an actual current failure. |
| Searchability | SELECT DropdownMenu supports enableFilter/enableSearch; master picker is searchable; MULTI_SELECT has search plus chips. | Positive evidence. Search does not solve wide chip groups or large selected lists. |
| Chip count | One current form (Hand Sanitizers) exposes a MULTI_SELECT with >8 choices; broad paint substrate chips appear elsewhere through profile/compiler changes. | MEDIUM for the exposed sanitizer; restrict its Paints scope. |
| Measurement dropdowns | Numeric dimensions pair with unit dropdowns filtered by LENGTH; shared Wallpaper dimensionUnit rendered beside both width and length. | MEDIUM clarity recommendation: one shared unit control or explicit independent units, chosen in metadata. |
| Conversion controls | Checkbox visible for every nonempty form; ON preview shown before valid inputs and does not live-update Contains. | CRITICAL U02 on 137 forms; also MEDIUM U01. Recalculate/validate base unit, restrict applicability, explain Contains, and validate before preview. |
| Image | Choose Image / Find Image disabled; Paste URL works and validates HTTP(S). | MEDIUM usability limitation: disclose available URL-only path clearly. |
| Save readiness | Empty selected template disables Save and warns; no classification still leaves Save button enabled before its error check. | MEDIUM affordance issue; invalid profiles with nonempty rows are not filtered/blocked. |
| Desktop/mobile responsiveness | 620/420 grids and 650 action breakpoint; current active category count and colour fields add scroll length. | Responsive code confirmed; fresh visual usability across all forms UNKNOWN. |

Per-template counts, labels, hints, main/technical visibility, options and findings are in section 4, so the shared checks were applied against every generated field set. This is not a claim that all mobile/desktop pixel layouts were executed.

## 15. Prioritized Fix Plan

This is a proposed future plan only. **No implementation, catalogue update or data migration was performed.**

### Top 10 most serious problems


| Priority | Problem | Why it matters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Converted-sale activation retains an out-of-template Base Unit on 137 forms (U02) | A completed Putty form can retain Bag and save 1 Bag = 20 Bags while its pack measurement is Kilogram. |
| 2 | Incomplete colour identity paths: nine unsupported ANY_VARIANT conditions and nine incomplete alternate-mode forms (C01/C02) | Fixed colours can be lost, or ready-colour/tintable products saved without shade/base identity. |
| 3 | Missing repository guard for nonempty valid template (A01) | UI missing-template protection can be bypassed by another caller. |
| 4 | Global-only unit validation and no canonical/attribute agreement (A02) | Wrong base/commercial/pack semantics can reach inventory; narrower menus alone are insufficient. |
| 5 | Edit classification changes discard SKU identities (A04) | New variants can be created while omitted old variants remain active under the product. |
| 6 | Hand Sanitizers exposed in Paints despite exclusion (S02) | Unrelated products use paint substrate/unit metadata. |
| 7 | Retired classifications on two active products; absent parent of one active variant (A08) | Real saved records do not satisfy current edit-form reference assumptions. |
| 8 | Profile/row drift: 37 missing-field, 69 placement and 74 default disagreements (A05) | The embedded profile differs from the form users receive. |
| 9 | Revision 5 data vs revision 1 heuristic compiler (A06/A07) | Next import can regress corrected forms; Wood branch masks Enamels. |
| 10 | Duplicate-name/ID ambiguity and ignored legacy aliases/default inference (A09) | Selection or reconciliation can substitute another meaning behind a familiar label. |

### Missing / legacy disposition


| Record group | Observed state | Proposed disposition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Paint → Interior Wall Paint / PM_SUBCATEGORY_ce0bf39843417fca | Zero active template rows; normal selector offers it | Resolve linked products to canonical taxonomy; provide a valid profile or stop normal creation. |

The ten retired SYSTEM categories themselves are **INACTIVE**, not obsolete ACTIVE catalogue choices: Accessories, Exterior Wall Paints, Floor Coatings, Industrial Coatings, Interior Wall Paints, Metal Paints, Primers & Putty, Wallpapers, Wall Textures and Wood Coatings. Their remaining use by saved products is the problem. No additional category is called “obsolete” solely from a broad name.

### Repair sequence and estimated effort


| Step | Proposed work | Estimated engineer/domain days | Exit evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Agree one authoritative profile schema; resolve embedded-profile versus field-row vocabulary; define scope and completeness checks | 2–3 | All active intended choices have one validated profile; no excluded/invalid choice appears. |
| 2 | Centralize resolution, defaults, condition scope, option aliases and unit semantics; enforce same contract in create/edit | 3–5 | Empty template and mismatched canonical units rejected; all five colour paths validated. |
| 3 | Reconcile every active catalogue row; correct priority families, missing fields and duplicates; verify with suppliers | 5–8 | Reviewed 149-ID audit has no unexplained profile/row differences; chemistry unknowns resolved. |
| 4 | Plan and implement reference/type/alias migration for existing products/variants without SKU identity loss; align sync revision/atomic import | 3–5 | Existing products editable; no orphan variants; repeated imports stable and preserve BUSINESS overrides. |
| 5 | Conversion/UX improvements and full automated/readable form audit plus desktop/mobile verification | 3–4 | Valid previews only; six transitions and Edit identity checks pass; no field-change REST reads; analyzer clean. |

Estimate: **16–25 person-days**, approximately 3–5 working weeks for one engineer with timely domain review. Supplier-data gaps, inventory references in other accounts and remote catalogue state can increase this. This estimate is an inference, not a commitment or authorization to write.

Existing test sources cover selected catalogue import, colour/pack validation, custom-option preservation, failed-page atomicity and some template transitions: [system_catalogue_test.dart](test/system_catalogue_test.dart), [dynamic_product_master_acceptance_test.dart](test/dynamic_product_master_acceptance_test.dart), [product_entry_form_test.dart](test/product_entry_form_test.dart), [product_repository_test.dart](test/product_repository_test.dart). None was executed here; the fixture is partial and does not establish all 149 current combinations as tested. A future fix should use an exhaustive read-only resolver diagnostic, then isolated test databases/widget tests, and finally `flutter analyze` with permission for its cache/generated-file effects.

### Preservation verification

Read-only comparison against the starting snapshot found **331 pre-existing inspected repository files unchanged**, with no additional file before report creation. Account SQLite SHA-256, size and modification time remained unchanged; no WAL/journal appeared. The only intended write is this requested Markdown report. Build/cache and hidden agent/config directories were excluded from the content-hash inventory and were not accessed for mutation. Final verification results are reported with the delivered artifact.
